aquaculture.def: The farming of fish, shellfish and seaweed in ponds, tanks or ocean pens.

food-desert.def: An area where people have poor access to affordable, healthy food, often a low-income area far from any supermarket.

food-insecurity.def: Not having reliable access to enough safe, nutritious food.

fair-trade.def: A labeling system in which buyers pay producers, often in less developed countries, a minimum price and a premium, under set labor and environmental rules.

community-supported-agriculture.def: An arrangement in which members pay a local farm in advance for a share of its harvest and share its risk; also called CSA.

value-added-crop.def: A farm product processed, branded or certified to earn more per unit, such as farmstead cheese or organic produce.
